'''Pyroclobster''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Pyroprawn]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Pyroviathan]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Dual claws blazing and roaring flames, Pyroclobster wields powerful fire fists to stand up for all Tatari. Life motto: float like a butterfly, sting like a prawn."

Pyroclobster is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A red crustacean with a white underbelly, blue eyes, and claws that resemble boxing gloves on fire. Its face is blue with a white X-shape between its eyes and extending off its head. The back of its head has a few spikes which transition from red to orange.

Pyroclobster's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with magenta.

== Evolution Trials ==
Pyroclobster's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Pyroviathan]] you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Feed this Tatari to B quality
* Use energy drink x20,000
* In [[Horde Invasion]], upgrade Pyroclobster to Lvl 7 or above for a total of 5 times.

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Pyroclobster's twin claws blaze with fire and can shoot out thermal shockwaves. Always follows a strict honor code to protect the weak.
